summary: The bill amends the Clean Air Act to allow year-round sales of E15 gasoline by removing Reid vapor pressure limits for 10-15% ethanol blends and to reform the renewable fuel standard by redefining small refining companies, ending most small-refinery exemptions after 2027, cutting their compliance obligations by 75% starting in 2028, restoring certain retired credits, and creating a capped hardship exemption for at-risk facilities.

scores.thoughts: The bill modifies Clean Air Act regulations related to gasoline volatility and the Renewable Fuel Standard Program, which directly impacts air quality and environmental regulations. By allowing E15 year-round and potentially nullifying state exclusions, it could affect air pollution levels, and returning compliance credits to small refineries also impacts environmental compliance.
